summary.text: Erica Mosca is a Democratic Nevada Assembly member from District 14 who has served since November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her as a consultant and the founder of Leaders in Training.

paragraphs.text: Mosca was born in San Diego, California, and lives in Las Vegas, Nevada.
She earned a B.S. from Boston University, an M.Ed. from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, and an Ed.M. from Harvard University.
Her career experience includes working as a consultant, and she founded Leaders in Training.
Mosca assumed office on November 9, 2022, succeeding Maggie Carlton.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Education and Ways and Means committees and chairs the Legislative Operations and Elections Committee.
